query:
SELECT 
  SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(coverImageUrl, '/', 3), '/', -1) as domain,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM projects 
WHERE coverImageUrl IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY domain;
